comparison.objective: Identify and place the water beaker on a hotplate while keeping acetone away; candidate finishes inserts.
comparison.physical_skill: Hazard-aware object selection and upright transport versus precision impact tooling and loose-fragment recovery.
comparison.success_condition: Water upright and released on the hotplate, acetone outside a 7.5 cm exclusion zone, no tipping or loss versus four safe fractures and contained tangs.
comparison.reason: The central ability is semantic hazard selection and transport, not mechanical fracture.
